subject: Consolidated renewal: GitHub / JetBrains / Atlassian — multi-product quote & timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com; george@github.com; nikita@jetbrains-sales.com; sales@atlassian-partner.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidated renewal opportunity — rollup + potential 3-product discount

Hi all,

Per our Q4 renewal calendar I pulled a rollup of our seats/licenses for GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains, and Atlassian products. I attached the CSV with per-team SKUs and renewal months. Short ask: can the vendor teams (GitHub, JetBrains, Atlassian partner) provide a consolidated quote and indicate where multi-product discounts would apply?

Key constraints:
- We have staggered expirations Jan–Apr 2027; prefer a single date if the pricing delta is <7%.
- We need a breakdown per BU for chargeback (engineering / platform / infra).
- Security/legal will need SLA and data residency clauses if we change tiers.

Marissa / Lauren — can you confirm the seat counts in the attachment match what procurement has on file? If yes, I’d like vendor quotes by Dec 10 so we can review at the leadership renewal sync on Dec 15.

Thanks — Ben

Attachments:
- current-license-rollup-2026.csv (CSV, 48KB)

--
Ben Carter

Hi Ben / team,

Thanks for the rollup — got it. We can put together a consolidated package that includes JetBrains and coordinate with GitHub/Atlassian for a cross-vendor tiered discount. A few quick clarifying questions before we price:

1) Are JetBrains renewals all on the same payment term today (annual, net30)?
2) Any seats in the rollup that are covered by education/nonprofit pricing?
3) Are you open to aligning on a single renewal date in exchange for a one-time consolidation fee credit?

I’ll circle back with a draft quote by Dec 8 once I confirm internal approvals. Attaching our standard quote template for your procurement team.

Regards,

nikita@jetbrains-sales.com

Team,

Thanks for pulling this together. High level direction: I approve pursuing a consolidated renewal if the total TCO (including any one-time consolidation fees) reduces our three-year spend or materially simplifies billing and support. Action items: 

- Marissa: work with procurement & legal to get the consolidated SOW and confirm the amortization approach; aim to have a final SOW by Dec 22.
- Ben: prioritize the vendor quotes and ask for a single invoice option and a breakdown by BU.
- Lauren: coordinate with finance on chargeback strings and whether we can centralize payment for a 1–2 quarter pilot.

If vendors can commit to fixed pricing for 12 months post-consolidation and provide at least one enterprise feature uplift (SAML session logs + central audit) as part of the package, I’m inclined to sign. Please keep me looped; I’ll be available for a short review on Dec 22 afternoon.

—Vivek
